name: Stripe.js (@stripe/stripe-js) and React Stripe.js (@stripe/react-stripe-js)
requested: @stripe/stripe-js 10.x and @stripe/react-stripe-js 7.x; the customer portal installs 10.2.1 and 7.0.1
summary: Stripe's browser SDK loader and TypeScript definitions (@stripe/stripe-js 10.2.1, pinned to the Stripe.js 'endive' release) and React Stripe.js 7.0.1 (Elements provider, useStripe/useElements, CardElement, PaymentElement and other Element components): READMEs, full type definitions for every Stripe.js method (confirmPayment, confirmCardPayment, createPaymentMethod, handleNextAction, confirmSetup, ...) and option, React source and examples, 10.x/7.x release notes.
coverage: Both packages at the exact versions the customer portal installs: READMEs, every TypeScript definition file of @stripe/stripe-js (types/, the de-facto API reference with JSDoc for each method), the loader source, every React Stripe.js source file (components, hooks, types), its hooks and class-component examples, the migration guide from react-stripe-elements, and GitHub release notes for 10.0.0-10.2.1 and 7.0.0-7.0.1.
gaps: The prose Stripe.js reference (docs.stripe.com/js, incl. react_stripe_js pages) and the Payment Element / 3-D Secure guides are not open-licensed; they are in the local-only stripe-guides set.
Source and type files are wrapped verbatim in Markdown code fences (<file>.md) so search can index them; no other changes.
Newer releases exist (@stripe/stripe-js 10.3.0, @stripe/react-stripe-js 7.1.0) and are not included; react-stripe-js CHANGELOG.md only points to GitHub releases.
Test files, Storybook stories, build config and lockfiles were left out.
notes: Versions are the ones the customer portal project installs (@stripe/stripe-js 10.2.1, @stripe/react-stripe-js 7.0.1, read from its node_modules); the newest releases in those lines are 10.3.0 and 7.1.0. Repos shallow-cloned at the release tags; nothing executed. stripe-js v10 loads https://js.stripe.com/endive/stripe.js (RELEASE_TRAIN in src/shared.ts).
